issues.issue: Hardcoded API key in source code (YOUR_API_KEY_HERE placeholder but pattern indicates secret in code).
issues.fix: Move API key to secure storage (e.g., Android Keystore or BuildConfig with proper obfuscation) and never hardcode secrets.

issues.issue: Cleartext HTTP URL (http://) used for API endpoint, allowing man-in-the-middle attacks and data interception.
issues.fix: Use HTTPS (https://) for all network requests and consider certificate pinning for sensitive endpoints.

issues.issue: No input validation on userId; potential path traversal or injection if userId contains special characters (e.g., '../').
issues.fix: Validate and sanitize userId (e.g., allow only alphanumeric characters) before concatenating into URL.

issues.issue: Exception is silently swallowed, hiding network or parsing errors which may mask security issues.
issues.fix: Log or handle exceptions appropriately without exposing sensitive data.
